title: 50% PDA quota, Rs 5,000 for unemployed: Akhilesh's big promises in UP manifesto
content: Akhilesh Yadav has unveiled the Samajwadi Party's PDA manifesto on Constitution Day ahead of the upcoming UP Assembly elections. The manifesto emphasizes the party's focus on backward classes, Dalits, and minorities, aiming to connect with diverse societal groups. By releasing it early, the SP intends to communicate its commitments effectively before the campaign begins. The party plans to contest the 2027 elections in alliance with Congress against the BJP.

title: Watch: Traffic cop dragged 50 feet on SUV bonnet after driver tries to evade challan
content: On Wednesday evening in Baramati, a constable attempted to stop a speeding SUV for traffic violations. The driver, Dheeraj Shedge, accelerated towards the officer, who clung to the vehicle's bonnet for nearly fifty feet. The constable suffered serious injuries to his left arm and leg during the incident. Police managed to apprehend Shedge within four hours of the incident in Satara district.

title: 32 trucks with Rs 4 crore rice left a year ago, vanished in MP
content: Authorities in Madhya Pradesh are delving into the case of 32 missing rice-laden trucks reported from Katni, which were meant for districts like Indore, Harda, and Neemuch. The investigation focuses on whether the shipments reached their destinations, were turned away, or diverted. With a potential conspiracy linked to illegal grain sales on their radar, officials emphasize the need for accountability regarding any negligence or pilferage by those involved.

title: India presents 2036 Olympic vision to IOC Future Host Commission in virtual meeting

The presentation highlighted infrastructure readiness, the 2030 Commonwealth Games, government support and India’s hosting experience, as the process moves towards strategic dialogue in March 2027.

title: Why Europe's biggest chip company does not want the US to cut China’s chip supplies
content: ASML CEO Christophe Fouquet has warned the US against cutting China off from chip technology, saying tougher export controls could push Beijing to build its own alternatives faster. Speaking on Semafor's Future Proof, he said ASML's older machines keep China reliant on Western tech. His remarks come as Washington tightens AI chip export rules after Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang's spy scandal involving Singapore-based firm Megaspeed.

title: Louisiana dad gives farm to brother, keeps life rights; children lose court bid
content: In Louisiana, a father's decision to transfer property to his brother, while retaining a lifetime residency right, sparked a legal battle after his death. His children contested the transfer, alleging it undermined their inheritance rights. However, the court found a lack of proof regarding inadequate living resources. The appeals court upheld the transfer, affirming the father's legal rights and the validity of his gift to his brother.

title: Five detained after court attack: Police detain five men; lawyers demand tighter security
content: Five assailants launched a violent attack on Mandar Kiwale outside the Pune district court on Wednesday afternoon. They shot at him and then attacked with billhooks, causing severe injuries. Witnesses reported the incident occurred in public view, leading to widespread panic among those present. Kiwale, recently released on bail, was in court related to a murder case. Police apprehended the attackers following a chase, and Kiwale remains in critical condition.

title: Pennsylvania judge halts historic farmhouse demolition; residents must raise $25,000

To prolong this halt, Save Forsythe Farm must secure $25,000 by November 30. Currently, they've garnered over $7,000 via a GoFundMe campaign aiming for $35,000. Due to safety concerns and the building's decline, West Goshen Township sought legal action.

title: Bezos’ ex-wife gave $62M landmark gift to meet 2030 goals of coastal communities
content: In December, MacKenzie Scott, the former spouse of Amazon's Jeff Bezos, generously donated $62 million to Blue Ventures. This substantial contribution will bolster global marine conservation and support small-scale fishing communities. The funds are aimed at improving food security and enhancing economic resilience for millions, while Blue Ventures is setting ambitious targets for community leadership by 2030, cherishing the trust this gift embodies for their mission.
